subject: Redwood marketplace inquiry — intro & demo
messages:
From: Elena Rojas <elena@cloudflux.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: cloudmarketplace@cloudmarket.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood listing inquiry — looking to schedule an intro/demo

Hi Marcus,

We came across Redwood on the Cloud Marketplace (listing looked great) and I started a trial this morning. I lead ML platform at CloudFlux — we run several internal LLMs and are evaluating inference cost and latency for high-concurrency endpoints.

Would love a quick 30–45 min intro + demo next week so we can:
- Walk through typical latency/cost tradeoffs for seq lengths ~1k
- See model routing and fallback behavior
- Ask about dedicated vs hosted for PII-handling workloads

Our core stakeholders: me (ML Platform), one infra lead, and one security lead. Are you available Mon/Tue next week (PST)? If you have a Calendly we can pick a slot.

Thanks,
Elena Rojas
Head of ML Platform, CloudFlux
elena@cloudflux.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: CloudFlux-usage-summary.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@cloudflux.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood listing inquiry — looking to schedule an intro/demo

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for starting the trial. Looping in Monica (our SDR) to coordinate timing and make sure we include the right SE.

Monica — can you propose a couple of 30–45m slots next week for CloudFlux? Prefer PST-friendly times; ideally include one morning and one late-afternoon option.

Elena — quick Q so the demo is productive: is there a particular throughput target (reqs/sec or concurrent requests) you expect in the first 3 months? Also flag any compliance must-haves up front so we include the right folks.

Calendly (if easier): https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m
Attaching a short intro deck so you have context ahead of the call.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0133
